snippet.title: Astrojunk - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
*Wishlist now on Steam* : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5085090/Astrojunk

Play in co-op as a crew of aliens racing to escape an impending meteor strike. Gather resources, fabricate scrap metal, survive brutal fabrication stations and assemble your spaceship to survive the chaos. Work together to build and launch before time runs out!
